title: Rosemary Focaccia

ingredientGroups.title: Dough
items: 1 ½ tsp bread machine/quick active dry yeast

steps: Add water and oil to the bread machine
Add flour, sugar, salt, and yeast to the bread machine, taking care that the yeast does not get wet yet.
Select the Dough cycle and let run, approximately 1h 30m.
When the dough cycle is complete, preheat the oven to 400° F.
While the oven preheats, turn the dough onto a lightly floured sheet-pan and flatten into a 12-14” circle.
Cover loosely with a towel and let rise for 15 minutes.
Uncover and make dimples all over the surface with your fingertips.
Drizzle with oil (3-4 Tbsp), then sprinkle with chopped rosemary and salt.
Bake 14 minutes or until light golden brown.
